title: Cryptomining Campaigns Exploiting Confluence OGNL Injection
text: CVE-2021-26084 is an OGNL injection flaw in Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center that yields unauthenticated remote code execution through a crafted request to vulnerable endpoints. In our telemetry the overwhelming majority of exploitation was opportunistic and financially motivated: within a week of disclosure, actors were mass-deploying XMRig cryptocurrency miners, occasionally alongside Behinder/Godzilla web shells for persistence. We assess this as critical for internet-facing instances. The technique emphasis here is resource hijacking for mining plus command execution, rather than data theft. Watch for Confluence's Java process spawning shells or curl/wget, and for high sustained CPU usage indicative of miners.
